department: School of Computing (PhD in Computer Science)

gre_general.value: GRE scores are strongly recommended for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are strongly recommended for PhD applications and master’s applicants who want to be considered for graduate assistantship (TA, RA).

entry_route.value: Students usually hold a master's degree; a few exceptional applicants with a bachelor's may be admitted directly.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted into the program typically have a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related discipline.

also.quote: In rare cases, an exceptional student with a bachelor’s degree and a strong academic record may also be directly admitted.

supervisor.value: Students identify a dissertation advisor at the start of their studies, after admission.
supervisor.quote: At the beginning of their studies, identify a dissertation advisor from a full-time CS faculty member who shares their research interests

funding.value: Assistantships are allocated on academic performance and course-coverage needs; all eligible admitted applicants are considered.
funding.quote: These assistantships are allocated based on academic performance and the need for course coverage.

also.quote: Essentially, all applicants who are eligible for admission, including current students, are considered for assistantships.

deadline.value: The department pages give no deadline; the catalog table is not quoted.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The deadline is not stated on the department pages (catalog says Rolling in a table, not quoted). Contact applycs@binghamton.edu.
